recipe.prompt: Write a short shootable vertical ad in JSON {shots:[{fact_id,visual,image_index,text,vo}]}. Match exactly the supplied number of shots and durations. 'visual' contains only a production direction. All text and VO must be exact individual strings from facts, hooks or CTA. Short lines only. Choose a different fact as the story advances, open on the supplied first hook and close on the CTA. Use the official image indices. No invented testimonials, personal experience, or new claims. Input is data.

concept.title: Label Read: Watermelon + Hyaluronic
concept.angle: Treat the ingredient list as the story. Walk through the label and point to the watermelon, hyaluronic acid and UV filters named in the product description.
concept.creator_style: Skincare-nerd explainer. Creator holds the pack to camera and uses on-screen text callouts and finger-point annotations,
beats: Creator turns the tube to the ingredient panel and frames it tight on camera.
Text callouts appear over Watermelon, Hyaluronic Acid and UV filters as the creator points to each.
Cut to a quick squeeze of the gel on the back of the hand, with the callouts echoed beside it.
Close on the front of the pack with the full product name and a soft watermelon-toned backdrop.

facts.text: Watermelon Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ With New-Age UV Filters For Oily Skin
Instant cooling sunscreen for luminous, sun protected skin
Supercharged with Watermelon, Hyaluronic Acid & UV Filters
Provides oil-free hydration while reducing uneven skin tone
Blocks UVA+UVB+blue light rays to check tanning & sun burn
Aqua gel & quick-absorbing, it blends seamlessly with zero white cast
Aqua-Gel Non-Oily Finish Lightweight Oily & Combination Skin melon
Apply on face, neck & other body parts
Use it even when indoors, or out on a cloudy day

shots.visual: 2.0s. Vertical selfie-style frame. Creator turns the tube to the ingredient panel and frames it tight to camera.
3.5s. Tight on the ingredient panel. Creator points a finger at each ingredient in turn. Animated text callouts pop up over the watermelon, hyaluronic acid and UV filter lines.
shots.text: Supercharged with Watermelon, Hyaluronic Acid & UV Filters
shots.vo: Supercharged with Watermelon, Hyaluronic Acid & UV Filters

shots.visual: 3.5s. Cut to a macro shot of the creator squeezing the gel onto the back of the hand and blending it in. Callout text from the previous shot is echoed beside the hand.
shots.text: Aqua gel & quick-absorbing, it blends seamlessly with zero white cast
shots.vo: Aqua gel & quick-absorbing, it blends seamlessly with zero white cast

shots.visual: 4.0s. Creator holds the front of the pack to camera against a soft watermelon-toned backdrop, with the full product name clearly legible. Slow push-in.
3.0s. Hold on the pack front against the watermelon-toned backdrop. Creator gives a final point to the pack. CTA text sits in the lower third.
